angleConvention: User chest screen-clockwise signs converted to Spine Y-up: windup +25deg, impact -35deg. Blade standard world angle +110 to -70 (art points +Y, so mount local compensates -90).
secondary: Delayed windup + 0.44s release overshoot; all rotations freeze in .30-.38.
curves: Spine 4.2 absolute time/value control points; 4 numbers per scalar, 8 per vector. Stepped constant/hold segments.
